title: Grateful Dead Live at Hollywood Palladium on 1972-09-09
lineage: 1st generation reels (Technics 1506) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz)> dBpoweramp (24/96) > Adobe Audition CC 2020 > TLH flac2496
source: Master Soundboard Cassettes (Uher deck) > Will Boswell's 1st generation reels @3.75 ips

ai_review.summary: Jam‑filled show captured on a decent‑mix soundboard tape that still sounds great after 50 years.
ai_review.review: The concert is praised for its abundance of enjoyable jams and a solid set list, delivering high energy throughout. The recording, despite being five decades old, is noted as sounding nice with a decent mix, making it pleasant to listen to today.

ai_rating.rationale: A single 5‑star review highlights strong musical performance and acceptable recording quality; with limited data the rating is high but confidence remains low.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Decent mix; sounds nice for a 50‑year‑old tape, no major flaws mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Good set list with plenty of jams and consistent energy.
